name: Azurelode Mine
summary: In southwestern Hillsbrad, Azurelode Mine sends iron to the Alliance war effort. Southshore's militia guards the human laborers who work its tunnels.

sections.title: Veins of the Foothills
sections.body: Southwest of the open farmland and just west of Southshore, Azurelode Mine cuts into the ridges along the coast. Human miners work deep underground under Foreman Bonds's watch, drawing iron for arms and armor. That iron helps Alliance defenders hold the region against the Undercity.

sections.title: A Vital Military Target
sections.body: Southshore's garrisons and town militia rely on Azurelode Mine for most of their raw iron. Tarren Mill targets the mine's workers and guards, seeking to break the supply lines that sustain Hillsbrad's human strongholds.

faq.answer: The Alliance controls Azurelode Mine, where human miners affiliated with Southshore and the Hillsbrad township work under Foreman Bonds.

faq.q: Why is the mine important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Azurelode Mine supplies iron to Southshore's armories and the local Alliance militia. Tarren Mill's leaders target the miners and overseers to cripple human weapon production in the Foothills.

faq.q: Was Azurelode Mine always part of Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: The accounts of this era do not say who held these hills before Hillsbrad. Today, miners from the Hillsbrad Fields work the mine under Foreman Bonds.
Azurelode Mine primarily produces iron ore for nearby human armories.

angles.text: The tunnels and ridges around Azurelode hold rich iron deposits, though Alliance miners guard the mine's interior fiercely.
Striking Azurelode Mine cuts off Southshore's fresh iron supply and supports the Forsaken offensive in the Foothills.
